summary: Recent updates to the Media IPC (Inter-Process Communication) area of Firefox include an important improvement for users on macOS, where the GLContextProviderEGL (a component responsible for handling OpenGL graphics rendering) will now be explicitly shut down. This change helps ensure that graphics resources are properly released when they are no longer needed, which can lead to better performance and stability when playing media. Overall, this update contributes to a smoother viewing experience, particularly for graphics-intensive content, while also reducing the likelihood of crashes or graphical glitches.
